# Marouan Boufernana — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Marouan Boufernana: Software Engineer, Game Developer, and 3D Artist. Showcases production fullstack web platforms, indie Unity games, 3D modeling and animation reels, work experience, and technical devlogs.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://marouan.boufer.com/): Overview and interactive introduction to Marouan Boufernana.
- [Experience](https://marouan.boufer.com/experience): Professional timeline including Tech Lead & Architect at Valinnov, fullstack engineering, and cloud microservices architecture.
- [Software Engineering](https://marouan.boufer.com/software): Production web and fullstack software projects.
- [Game Development](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Commercial and game-jam indie games built with Unity.
- [3D Modeling & Animation](https://marouan.boufer.com/3d-art): Blender hard-surface modeling, physics rigs, and mechanical animation reels.
- [Blog](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog): Essays, engineering notes, postmortems, and game design studies.
- [Connect](https://marouan.boufer.com/connect): Contact information and social profiles.

## Featured Projects & External Links
- [Moraja3ati](https://moraja3ati.ma/): Production EdTech & AI tutoring web platform for Moroccan students (React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker).
- [Walls & Tower Party](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Online multiplayer indie game published on Steam and Google Play.
- [Scrap Vanguard](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Action survival game built in Unity.
- [Itch.io Games](https://marouan-boufer.itch.io/): Playable game jam entries including Under Under, Cursed Demons, and Agent Diplegia.

## Blog & Writing
- [What Makes a Game Fun? Zelda BOTW](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/what-makes-a-game-fun-botw): How Breath of the Wild redefined fun.
- [Anti-Boredom Mechanics: BOTW & MGSV](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/preventing-player-boredom-botw-mgsv): Preventing the player from boring themselves.
- [Creating Your Own Game Design Tools](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/creating-your-own-game-design-tools): Using AI-built React prototypes to test game mechanics before implementing them in Unity.
- [Between a Hobby and a Business](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/bleeding-edge-hobby-and-business): Why solo devs struggle to keep sales pressure from hurting creative choices, and why creation and publishing belong apart.
- [Frameworks That Explain Abstractions](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/frameworks-that-explain-abstractions): Software frameworks that clarify complexity.
- [How Game Pace Controls the Player](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/how-game-pace-controls-the-player): Tempo, tension, and player emotion.
- [Insights From Feedback & Analytics](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/insights-from-feedback-and-analytics): Extracting signal from playtests and telemetry.
- [Balance and Imbalance in Silksong](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/balance-and-imbalance-in-silksong): Deliberate imbalance in combat and progression.
- [AI Can Code Now. Good for Us](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/ai-can-code-now-good-for-us): Systems thinking and taste in the AI era.
- [Is Art Really Dying?](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/is-art-really-dying): Craft, originality, and human expression.
- [The Game Jam Experience Before AI](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/game-jam-experience-before-ai): Building prototypes from scratch before AI assistants.
- [Moroccan Gaming Expo 2025](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/moroccan-gaming-expo-2025): Floor notes from Morocco Gaming Expo 2025.
- [Walls & Tower: Cardboard to Steam](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/walls-and-tower-cardboard-to-steam): Ten-year journey from cardboard to Steam.
- [Scrap Vanguard: Letting Go of Ideas](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/scrap-vanguard-letting-go-of-old-ideas): Cutting mechanics that hold the core game back.
- [Scrap Vanguard: Demo Results](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/scrap-vanguard-demo-results): Metrics and player feedback from the public demo.
- [Under Under & Failed Prototypes](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/under-under-agent-diplegia-failed-prototype): Lessons from Under Under and Agent Diplegia.
